title: Design System: Mountain Culture Guitar Lessons

display-light.purpose: The Weight Contrast Rule: thin (300) connective words in the hero masthead only ("Turn", "Into A").

brush.purpose: One hand-marked emphasis word per hero only. Carried over from the prior identity, recolored to mauve.

label.purpose: Nav links, button text, eyebrows, tag bars. Uppercase with letter-spacing.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation (Tailwind shadow-sm). Neutral, no color tint -- the No-Glow Rule.

shadows.name: card-featured
shadows.purpose: The one featured card per section (Tailwind shadow-xl), paired with a 2-4px slate border.

motion.name: press-compress
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on primary buttons.

motion.name: badge-entrance
motion.value: fade + rise, 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), once on load
motion.purpose: One-time attention flourish on the hero's status badge -- never looped, since it is static copy, not live data.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid slate pill button, white text -- the system's action color.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Book a Lesson <svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #3F5A72; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 13px; padding: 16px 36px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -8px rgba(63,90,114,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #344A5E; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3F5A72; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Solid sage pill button for the persistent header CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #6B8169; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #5A6E58; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: White card with a tinted icon circle, soft shadow, thin border that deepens on hover.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(42,42,37,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(42,42,37,0.08); transition: border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #6B8169; transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(174,192,171,0.4); color: #6B8169; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; color: #2A2A25; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { color: #73706A; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Featured Pricing Card
components.description: White card with a thick slate border and deep neutral shadow -- the Spotlight slot.
components.css: .ds-card-featured { background: #FFFFFF; border: 4px solid #3F5A72; border-radius: 24px; padding: 40px; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(42,42,37,0.12); color: #2A2A25; } .ds-badge-value { position: absolute; top: -16px; right: 24px; background: #3F5A72; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-card-featured-title { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-price { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 56px; font-weight: 900; color: #3F5A72; margin: 16px 0 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Cream form field used throughout the booking modal.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #73706A; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #F4EFE4; border: 1px solid rgba(42,42,37,0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #2A2A25; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3F5A72; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(63,90,114,0.2); }

components.name: Decorative Circles
components.description: Two to three overlapping oversized soft-tone circles behind a photo frame -- the signature cut-paper device. Reserved for photography only.
components.css: .ds-circle-wrap { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 400px; } .ds-circle { position: absolute; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-circle-mauve { top: -24px; left: -24px; width: 220px; height: 220px; background: #D3B3AC; } .ds-circle-sage { bottom: 0; right: 8px; width: 180px; height: 180px; background: #AEC0AB; } .ds-photo { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 32px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(42,42,37,0.15); }

components.name: Brush Highlight
components.description: Signature hand-marked word treatment, carried over from the prior identity and recolored to mauve. One word per hero, never repeated.
components.css: .ds-brush { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 48px; color: #2A2A25; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-brush::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px -12px; background: #D3B3AC; z-index: -1; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); border-radius: 6px; clip-path: polygon(0% 15%, 100% 0%, 98% 85%, 2% 100%); }

narrative.overview: The system reads as a calm, plant-filled teaching studio on a Sunday morning -- warm cream paper, muted sage and dusty mauve color-blocks, a confident slate-blue for action, and soft natural light rather than stage glow. Where the old identity shouted from a dark stage, this one invites you in from a sunlit room. Overlapping color-blocked circles sit behind the instructor's photo like cut-paper shapes -- an editorial, scrapbook-adjacent composition rather than a poster. The one handwritten touch survives from the old system, recolored, as continuity of personality rather than identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground with white cards; soft shadows and thin charcoal-tinted borders instead of dark-theme glow
Three accent families (sage, mauve, slate), each with a light/soft tint for decoration and a deeper tone for text and buttons
Overlapping color-blocked circles as the signature decorative device, specifically behind photography
Mixed-case, mixed-weight display type replaces the old all-caps poster voice
One surviving signature: the hand-marker highlight on a single hero word, now in mauve instead of yellow

rules.name: The Deep/Light Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every accent family ships two tones: a deep one for text, borders, and buttons, and a soft one for decoration. Never use the soft tone where text needs to sit on it directly.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: The hero masthead mixes a thin (300) connective weight against the system's heavy (900) emphasis weight. Section headings elsewhere stay single-weight 900.

rules.name: The One Brush Rule
rules.body: Caveat is the system's single handwriting moment. It marks one word in the hero and nowhere else.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from a real offset-and-blur shadow, never a zero-offset colored halo. This is a deliberate reversal of the old system's Spotlight glow.

dos: Do pair every accent's deep tone (text/buttons) with its own soft tone (decoration) -- never cross them.
Do keep elevation as a real offset-and-blur shadow; no colored glow anywhere in this system.
Do reserve the overlapping decorative circles for photography, not plain cards or text blocks.
Do keep Caveat/brush typography to one word, one time, per hero.
Do keep buttons fully rounded (pill) -- the system's one consistent button shape.
donts: Don't reintroduce the old system's zero-offset colored glow shadow; it is explicitly retired by this redesign.
Don't stack two bordered/backgrounded containers inside each other for ordinary content.
Don't animate a status badge or indicator unless it represents genuinely live, changing data.
Don't use the soft/light accent tint anywhere text needs to sit directly on it -- contrast fails.
